descriptionChirho: The masculine noun אָבִיר used as a divine epithet, 'Mighty One (of Jacob/Israel)', occurring 6 times in construct or prepositional phrases. All occurrences carry the same semantic weight of divine power and strength. Multilingual evidence confirms uniform meaning: eng 'Mighty One of', spa 'Fuerte de / Poderoso de', hin शक्तिशाली / सामर्थी, arb عَزِيز / قَدِير, kor 전능자, swa 'Mwenye nguvu wa'. The prepositional form (S79626 'to/for the Mighty One') is a grammatical variant of the same sense.
